questions.executed_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment = 'Enterprise'), 2) AS enterprise_net_revenue_2025, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS total_net_revenue_2025, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment = 'Enterprise') / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue), 0), 4) AS enterprise_revenue_share FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_of_orders FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC

SELECT customer_segment, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value_eur, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS invoiced_orders, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_eur FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY average_order_value_eur DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country, c.segment, ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue_last_12_months FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE s.invoice_date > CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '12 MONTHS' AND s.invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country, c.segment ORDER BY net_revenue_last_12_months DESC LIMIT 10
